messages:
carmen: quick heads-up — the analytics team pushed a campaign forecast for next week, looks like a 35% bump in evening shoulder (18:00-22:00 UTC)
liam: do we have a current baseline for tokens/sec and concurrent reqs during that window?
carmen: baseline avg 12k tokens/sec per region, peak conc 1800 reqs in eu-west during 19:00 UTC last wednesday
jena: from sims earlier, our 1x GPU (A100-like) sustained token throughput ~22k tokens/sec when multiplexed, but latency tail rises once concurrent >2200 for that region
liam: rough calc — if campaign pushes concurrent to 2400 and avg tokens per req stays ~120, tokens/sec becomes ~28.8k => we need ~1.3 GPUs more than current pool to keep same headroom
oliver: can you drop the math? i'm on mobile
carmen: simple: (concurrent * avg_tokens / avg_resp_time) => target tokens/sec. using 2400 * 120 / 1.0s = 288k tokens/sec across cluster, but per-gpu measured 22k so 288k/22k ~ 13.1 GPUs total vs current 11 = need +2.1 => plan +3 pre-warm
liam: note avg_resp_time will increase with queueing, so those numbers are optimistic. we normally target 25% headroom for safety :head_dash:
jena: i ran a sensitivity sweep this morning — knee at 2100-2300 concurrent for eu-west, beyond that P99 latency jumps x1.8. attaching quick dump: ```
concurrent, p50, p95, p99
2000, 54ms, 120ms, 210ms
2200, 58ms, 150ms, 320ms
2400, 80ms, 260ms, 590ms
```
ops-bot: capacity-check: current eu-west active GPUs=11, reserved=12, preemptible pool=4, avg_gpu_util=76%
carmen: given the forecast and sensitivity results, proposal: spin 2 reserved GPUs early-morning (02:00 UTC) day-before, enable burst from preemptible pool at 17:30 UTC, and bump autoscale threshold to 68% so scale-up happens earlier
liam: cost check: 2 reserved GPUs for 7 hours => ~14 GPU-hours. at list commit price that's ~ $280 (est). preemptible burst costs ~30% lower but risk eviction
oliver: is there a quick config diff we can apply to the scale policy? i can push a canary change
carmen: yes — policy snippet: ```
scale_policy:
  region: eu-west
  target_util: 68
  cooldown: 120
  min_reserve: 12
  preemptible_burst: true
```
jena: also suggest enabling prefix cache warmup for that region to reduce real token load — saves ~9-12% tokens/sec during shoulder
liam: agree. action items: 1) carmen spin 2 reserved GPUs via infra runbook by EOD, 2) oliver push scale_policy canary to staging, 3) jena enable prefix warmup flag and run validation, 4) ops-bot monitor p95/p99 and msg channel if p99 > 500ms
carmen: i'll take 1 and coordinate with infra ops. prepping runbook now. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: scheduled checks added: start=2240190000, check_interval=300s, alert_on=p99>500ms
oliver: got it, will do the canary after carmen confirms runbook
jena: i'll rerun the sensitivity sim after warmup toggles and post a follow-up in the thread
liam: thanks all — want to reconvene tomorrow 16:00 UTC if numbers change
carmen: SG, will post updates here.
